name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's motorsport journey began in his youth, captivated by the roar of engines and the precision of racing machines at Suzuka Circuit. Initially drawn to engineering, he earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After a brief stint as a junior engineer at a small tuning shop, Kenji joined Target Racing as a data analyst, quickly impressing his superiors with his sharp insights and dedication.

Over the years, Kenji's organizational skills and understanding of team dynamics propelled him through the ranks. He transitioned into a race engineer role, then became the team manager, before finally ascending to the role of team principal. Known for his data-driven approach and commitment to fostering a collaborative environment, Kenji emphasizes open communication and continuous improvement within the team. His strength lies in his ability to adapt strategies on the fly and cultivate a supportive atmosphere for his team members.

What distinguishes Kenji is his willingness to take calculated risks, believing that innovation is crucial for staying ahead in the competitive world of motorsport. He constantly seeks out new technologies and methodologies, encouraging his team to experiment and challenge conventional approaches. His flexible leadership style allows him to adapt to the unique needs of each team member, fostering a high-performance culture built on mutual respect and trust.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a lean build, and often wears thin-rimmed glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having green tea before every race.
